1293162.title: Thieves Highway

1660778.title: Mel
1660778.overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

1687274.title: In illo αTempore
1687274.overview: 19th part (R. 19 bis) of interdisciplinary cycle REQUIEM. "I imagine that almost everyone who has come across this piece is familiar with the phrase 'in illo tempore'. In illo tempore—in that time. [...] Let’s pause for a moment on 'tempore'. Let’s consider, as laypeople might, what part of the original phrase this is. Of course, it is technically 'time.' [..] When an extra letter 'a' appeared in my mind—which has a tendency to complicate all sorts of concepts to the limit—it completely changed the perspective of everything. 'aTempore' was born. What did that mean to me? If 'tempore' is, theoretically, '(at) that time,' then 'aTempore' would mean 'non-time.' Now we have 'That Non-Time.' Does this mean we should think of time that has stopped? Or perhaps of different spaces, sensations? [...]" - as the introductionary note to the movie says.

1695722.title: Revelations
1695722.overview: Nuca, one of the world’s leading bee specialists, celebrates her birthday surrounded by family traditions. As the family matriarch, time is relentless in its toll on her memory loss. In an attempt to remember, she revisits family photographs, and as the past and present intertwine, secrets begin to surface. At this celebration, it won't just be the photos that are revealed.

1699114.title: Hellas 3.0
1699114.overview: Three stories. Three directorial perspectives. A cinematic triptych that navigates between humor, absurdity, and Greek reality. Three different filmmakers join forces in a cinematic triptych that observes contemporary Greek reality through humor, absurdity, and a satirical lens.

1701994.title: Visiting the Zoo
1701994.overview: A glimpse into the lives of three characters who move through the city like animals in a zoo, gradually reconnecting with their primordial instincts. Until they erupt in a final confrontation with real animals, breaking free.

1702378.title: A Long Ride Home
1702378.overview: Mick learns about the death of his father through a phone call. Now he needs to return to a home he hasn't been to in 25 years to face his Demons.  Director J. Robert Bellamy originally wanted this story to be told in film format, but would only get funding to make it as a series for Bell Fibe. This version is his definitive vision.
1702378.trailerName: A Long Ride Home - Official Trailer | Fibe TV1

1702890.title: Imprint
1702890.overview: In a near-future where knowledge can be traded for citizenship, a desperate mother buys an immigrant’s expertise to give her daughter a competitive edge - at a cost she never imagined.

1702954.title: …And I Saw Your Name on the Dust of the Houses.
1702954.overview: At seventy-two, my grandmother Rosi wanders among the properties she built in the past as she searches for her place in the world while dealing with the pain of loss and abandonment.
1702954.original_title: …y vi tu nombre en el polvo de las casas.

1703402.title: Do you see what i see?
1703402.overview: In a world  infiltrated by halucinations, a man refuses to leave a relationship that has already ended and continues living inside it.

1704746.title: Dogwood
1704746.overview: A grad student, home for the week and bouncing back from depression, reencounters an old "friend".

1705450.title: Bheemseri
1705450.overview: A ruthless police officer misuses her power, destroying a poor family in a brutal act of injustice. The lone survivor, a strong and determined woman, rises from the ashes with a burning desire for revenge. As she hunts the officer, dark truths unravel, leading to a gripping face-off between power, guilt, and justice.
1705450.trailerName: Bhishmar Official Trailer | East Coast Vijayan | Dhyan Sreenivasan| Vishnu Unnikrishnan|Divya Pillai

1705898.title: Girl Talk
1705898.overview: Over an extended period, a director engages in an ongoing conversation with Yu, a teenage girl trying to come out of her experience of sexual trauma. A dialogue built on trust, the film follows Yu as she gradually learns to assert herself while the director remains present and open in the process. Through her social encounters, her words, and the short films she makes, Yu reflects on how she has been seen and defined, and begins to reclaim control of her own story. Resisting the label of “victim,” she moves forward with a firm step into the world.

1706538.title: Sundown Syndrome
1706538.overview: A homeless eats a strange biscuit and begins to hallucinate; everything around him becomes an evil space.

1706730.title: Hijamat
1706730.overview: Fifty-year-old Murad’s life is shaken to the core when he learns that his younger brother is gay. Murad would like to support his brother, but their traditional Muslim family is against it. As a result, he finds himself subjected to pressures from all sides – from his father, who has close ties to the local imam, and from his brother’s circle of friends as well. He would like to help everyone, but as he slowly falls into a spiral of conflicts and mounting difficulties, he finds that he, too, is in need of help. Another integral part of this family drama is the theme of migration and dialogue – not just between different religions, but within communities themselves.

1707626.title: Sumpa Kingdom
1707626.overview: Raised in inland China, the protagonist Yangqing Lamu meets Baima, a young local guide, during an accidental trip to the plateau. The two travel deep into pastoral grasslands, embarking on a spiritual exploration of marriage, life and death, and morality amid the conflicts between dreams and reality, tradition and individuality. In the end, she achieves a profound reconciliation with both her homeland and her inner self in the vast wilderness.

1708394.title: Stitches
1708394.overview: Three isolated men submit to rituals of healing—an AI cleanse, a live stream of penance, and an experimental drug trial—each descending into madness as their pain becomes performance in a world obsessed with watching.

1709738.title: Backrooms (Gorilla Tag Movie)
1709738.overview: A lonely museum worker named Mark accidentally discovers the Backrooms, an endless maze of strange yellow rooms hidden beyond reality. After escaping, he becomes obsessed with uncovering its secrets, but the experience begins to destroy his life and sanity. When a terrifying presence appears to follow him into the real world, Mark and his friends venture back into the labyrinth in search of answers. As fear, paranoia, and death consume the group, Mark is forced to confront a horrifying truth that changes everything he thought he knew about the Backrooms—and himself. A Gorilla Tag fan film of the movie "Backrooms".

1709866.title: Speaking Dead
1709866.overview: When a massive terror threat paralyzes downtown Seoul, former forensic scientist Jang Jae-wook arrives trailing a mysterious suitcase—containing a dead body instead of explosives. The dark shadow of a decade-old military incident comes to light, revealing a massive web of corruption spun by a deeply entrenched cartel of power. As the dead begin to speak, the buried truth is finally dragged into the light.

1713130.title: Mon Gohine
1713130.trailerName: Mon Gohine | মন গহীনে | Farhan Ahmed Jovan | Aisha Khan | S R Mozumder | Bangla New Natok 2026

1713706.title: Love/Bug
1713706.overview: A couple, affectionately naming each other Love and Bug, test the limits of their love living with each other for fifteen months.

1713962.title: Night of Blood
1713962.overview: Six strangers enter a cash-prize endurance challenge at the Val Verde Hotel, a location infamous for a fatal explosion and rumors of being haunted. Instead of being stalked by a physical, masked serial killer, the contestants face immersive, supernatural scares when the hauntings at the hotel turn out to be all too real.

1714794.title: The Mirror's Echo
1714794.overview: A grieving teen discovers that her deceased twin sister is communicating through her vanity mirror, but the entity reflecting back is far from a sibling.

1715754.title: Beings
1715754.overview: A lady from the 1920s works at her desk when suddenly she gets approached by unknown entities.

1715818.title: A Spark Into A Flame: Hamilton & Hip Hop
1715818.overview: Lin-Manuel Miranda and others set hip-hop and Broadway on fire in The Hamilton Mixtape.

1716842.title: Latina
1716842.overview: A story about a mysterious woman who shakes up a seemingly ordinary boarding house. As she charms both the boys and girls, secrets unravel, relationships collide, and chaos takes over.
1716842.trailerName: LATINA Official Trailer | World Premiere this June 19 on VMX

1718506.title: Baa: Ek Yoddha
1718506.trailerName: BAA - Ek Yoddha | OFFICIAL MOVIE TRAILER - 2 |DIVYA DEV |JHARNA THAPA |SUHANA THAPA|ANIL BUDHATHOKI

1719978.title: YEG: A Turkic Folktale
1719978.overview: A desperate father prays to Tengri to save his sick son. When a mysterious stranger arrives with dark tales of ancient Turkic dragons, fear, madness, and curses consume the family, leading them toward a bloody and tragic fate.

1720298.title: Тихие смыслы
1720298.overview: The Nizhny Novgorod Youth Theatre troupe is rehearsing William Gibson's play "The Miracle Worker." In search of authenticity, the actors find themselves behind the scenes of blindness and deafness. They enter the real world of a boy named Petya, his mother, and his teacher. Episodes from the play about the education of a deaf-blind child unexpectedly echo real life, but reality is always more complex and profound than fiction.

1720938.title: HOW TO UNMASK A FCKN INCEL?
1720938.overview: Matías, an introverted young man and rock music enthusiast, agrees to go out with his roommate, Hugo, unaware that they'll end up at a gay nightclub. There, he tries to connect with Gloria and fit into an environment that feels foreign to him, but his insecurities, prejudices, and social awkwardness lead to a series of uncomfortable situations. When Celine confronts him about his attitude toward women, Matías is forced to confront an image of himself he had never questioned.

1723434.title: GREEN
1723434.overview: A young woman and a young man—lifelong friends—reflect on love through someone else's story, without realizing that love might be closer than they think.

1724778.title: Saint Anthony
1724778.overview: A darkly comic portrait of a troubled young man on the day of his mother’s funeral.

1725546.title: The Other Ones
1725546.overview: Invoking the wrath of an ancient terror, a mother and daughter must rely on one another to confront the trauma that has plagued their family over generations.

1726186.title: Le Mal Des Ardents
1726186.overview: In a small village ravaged by wars and epidemics, Vera becomes the perfect target and is accused of witchcraft. But her unexplained disappearance during her execution leads her sister Michelle to investigate what really happened.

1726314.title: Maharashtra Epstein Files
1726314.overview: Plot TBA; inspired by the real-life scandal surrounding the self-styled godman Ashok Kharat alias 'Captain'.

1727082.title: Baby Daddy
1727082.overview: A lonely three-year-old pulls out a chunk of his dad's beard, plants it in the garden, and grows a new best friend.

1727146.title: Ladies and Gentlemen, Brian Mulroney
1727146.overview: Haunted by visions of the future. Vilified by the political establishment. Charming beyond belief. Behold the dazzling ascent of Brian Mulroney, the “Boy from Baie-Comeau” who built a brand-new Canada.

1728554.title: Before America
1728554.overview: Before America is a cinematic documentary uncovering the Indigenous histories of Michigan long before the United States existed. From the 1763 uprising at Fort Michilimackinac to Odawa trail trees and the overlooked women of Fort Detroit, the film reveals how Anishinaabe nations shaped Great Lakes history and helped spark the chain of events that ultimately pushed the American colonies.

1733418.title: Ürei
1733418.overview: When a young girl is left with her aging grandmother in rural Kazakhstan, an ordinary act of familial care quickly turns into an unsettling descent into the unknown where loss can take monstrous forms.

1734826.title: FAMILIAR
1734826.overview: A little girl and her mother look through an old photo album when a disturbing presence ruins the moment.

1734954.title: Scavenged
1734954.overview: After the apocalypse, Bella becomes the target of rival survivor factions who believe she represents humanity's future. Protected by her father's best friend, Josh, she must survive betrayal, zombies, and war in a fight for hope.

1736042.title: Objection My Lord
1736042.overview: A father burns himself alive outside the Hyderabad High Court, demanding justice for his missing daughter, Sameera. When the system moves on and forgets, one question remains.Did Sameera ever exist? A forgotten lawyer, Parshuram, is forced out of self imposed exile to fight for the answer.

1736106.title: Come to Brasil
1736106.overview: Look in the comment section of any celebrity and you'll see one comment more than any other: “Come to Brasil.” In the west, the phrase is brushed off as a meme, but for Brazilian fans, it's a rallying cry, a plea that unites fandoms in a country that even the biggest stars pass over on their so-called "world" tours. Through the eyes of four Rio de Janeiro pop music superfans, the most popular comment on the internet is explored as a vessel to highlight the uniting forces of music and the resilience of music lovers.

1736490.title: A Bit of Light
1736490.overview: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, an Iranian doctor loses faith in the future and resolves to end his life - but one final day among his family begins to unsettle his decision.

1739690.title: Sisters of the Shattered Moon
1739690.overview: When a teenage girl discovers the corruption of her futuristic suburban idyll in the clouds, she is expelled to a vast underworld of endless night.

1740842.title: Sa Mga Nagdaan at Lumipas
1740842.overview: Ella, a mourning queer archivist, reminisced about her lover by preserving a historical video documenting the first Pride March in the Philippines in 1994 which features them both.

1741994.title: Baggage Claim
1741994.overview: Upon learning of their mother's untimely death, lone-stoner Abby and type-A brother Ben must embark on a body identification road trip home to claim her corpse - along with their own personal baggage.

1742186.title: Thicker Than Water
1742186.overview: Two estranged best friends find a way to reconnect after they discover a regenerative wine and begin testing its limits on each other.

1742442.title: Steel: The Blood of Us
1742442.overview: Steel: The Blood of Us is a cinematic love letter to the end of the industrial revolution, capturing the community of Port Talbot, Wales, in the final years of traditional steelmaking. Through raw, poetic storytelling and evocatively shot on 16mm film it weaves together the voices of generations to celebrate a way of life on the brink of vanishing.
1742442.trailerName: Steel: The Blood of Us | Official Trailer

1745962.title: Wendy (Mao Remix)
1745962.overview: Official music video for “Wendy (Remix)”, the electronic reinterpretation of the Delta V track by Italian singer-songwriter Mao, released on 31 July 2026 as the closing chapter of the album “In fatti ostili RMX”. Mao’s remix holds the voice back for almost two minutes while the arrangement circles and expands, projecting the original songwriting into a nocturnal and rarefied space.  Directed by Brussels-born, Montreal-based filmmaker Nicolas Fransolet and shot entirely in Tokyo, the film has no protagonist and no narrative. It follows the city through a single arc of hours, from daylight into night, moving inside the flow of streets, stations and suburbs. The images are observed rather than staged: what appears on screen is what happened in front of the lens.  What emerges is the portrait of a place at once distant and familiar, where the vast scale of the metropolis and the smallness of individual gestures inhabit the same frame. Proximity and connection almost never coincide.

1747946.title: Box of Memories
1747946.overview: Days after running away from home, Pablo roams the streets with nothing but a backpack. One night he comes across Regina, who knows the streets by heart, the two end up bonding over photographs, as they both use them as a means of escape.

1748010.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing
1748010.overview: Documentary on the making and legacy of Mulberry Street featuring new interviews with cast and crew

1748138.title: Black Beauty
1748138.overview: Sroy, a former famous actress known for her irresistible charm, discovers that her husband, Sin, a powerful and influential politician, has been secretly having an affair with a young female university student. She therefore joins forces with her Affair to bring them both public humiliation.

1748714.title: Doubt
1748714.overview: Shortly before taking his vows to become a priest, Jean decides to join a Catholic monastery to see if he is better suited to monastic life. The arrival of a visitor, a handsome young man, awakens unsettling feelings within him, forcing him to confront his convictions.

1752170.title: Miolo
1752170.overview: The June Festival is approaching, when the bumba-meu-boi is traditionally celebrated in São Luís. Codó is the “miolo”, the dancer who brings the enchanted bull to life. Yet he finds himself under pressure from the end of his lease, the loss of his job contract, and the progres­sion of his father’s Alzheimer’s, whom he cares for alone.

1753066.title: Kudiyan Shehar Diyan
1753066.overview: Three ambitious women leave their small towns for the city, chasing successful careers while facing tough choices that threaten their relationships, values, and identities.
1753066.trailerName: Kudiyan Shehar Diyan (Official Trailer) New Punjabi Movie 2026 | Rel on 20 Aug at Chaupal

1753322.title: Para atrapar el viento
1753322.overview: A young man chases a rebellious gust of wind across the hills as it creates chaos and music through the grassland.

1755882.title: Titser, titser!
1755882.overview: In honor of their aging music teacher suddenly retiring, a group of underdogs sets out to give the best Battle of the Bands performance before their moving-up ceremony.

1756138.title: Who Is Martin Mull?
1756138.overview: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

1756458.title: За чертой
1756458.overview: Two spirits meet in the bustle of modern China. Their invisible journey through the metropolis brings the past and the future into conflict. While the spirits debate the value of memory and progress, three artists—a calligrapher, a graffiti artist, and a poet—search for an answer to this same question in the present through their work, building a bridge between tradition and modernity.

1757098.title: LOUF
1757098.overview: In his debut feature documentary, Aziz Zoromba follows acclaimed chef Fadi Kattan and Canadian co-venturer Nicole Mankinen as they race to open a Palestinian restaurant in Toronto. While their dream takes shape, escalating attacks devastate Gaza and the West Bank. Part immersive food film and part urgent record, LOUF is a powerful meditation on diaspora, resistance, and the politics of preservation.

1757482.title: The Guardian
1757482.overview: A young security guard begins his first night shift at an abandoned condominium slated for demolition. To survive until dawn, he must document the night with a video recorder and strictly follow a list of unsettling rules recorded on a cell phone by the previous guard. As the hours pass, he confronts paranormal events and spectral presences.

1757610.title: Happy Good Rest
1757610.overview: After the sudden loss of their father, a pair of siblings Laila and Raga are compelled to retell his passing to each family member, each holding on to their own version of the truth, until grief itself begins to question what it means to grieve.

1757930.title: Olgas Boris and the quest for the hidden Niches
1757930.overview: Tyrol (Austria) 2024: Olgas Boris sets out on a journey into hidden niches — and along the way encounters Singacross, the choir of the State Music School Schwaz. Together, they bring music to unusual locations. Will they discover the hidden niches?
1757930.original_title: Olgas Boris und die Suche nach den verborgenen Nischen

1759146.title: Aineolach
1759146.overview: When a grieving gay minister relocates to a remote Hebridean village to preach, he's met with a few frosty smiles and silent judgement. But as the island's first Pride begins to bloom in secret, he must choose between blending in or standing up — risking his peace, his purpose, and maybe even his heart.

1760170.title: Rode to Ruin
1760170.overview: Keaton will portray retired Marshal Henry Tillman, and Freeman is a wanted outlaw named Joseph Mulberry. The U.S. Marshal searched forty years for his wife’s killer, and the cold trail finally heats up and leads him to an aging outlaw losing his memory – and to a buried truth neither man may survive.

1760298.title: Not Waiting for Christmas
1760298.overview: Vilius, a popular radio host, is getting ready to celebrate Christmas with his wonderful family. The pleasant anticipation of the holidays is disrupted by unexpected news: his parents, who left him with his grandmother when he was just a little boy and moved to America, are returning to live in Lithuania.

1765226.title: Walk with Death
1765226.overview: Briana Popoca Salpeter is a death doula in Austin’s Indigenous community. In this documentary short, she shares about her calling for grief and death work and what it has taught her.

1765738.title: Tymek
1765738.overview: After relocating to rural Ireland, a defiant Polish teen finds himself at odds with everything around him - especially his father. Stuck in a place that feels nothing like home, their clashes simmer until rebellion turns personal, and the fallout becomes impossible to ignore.
